historical_references.reference: Ivanshi was an ancient Indian king and the founder of the Ikshvaku dynasty, which is believed to have ruled from approximately 1300 BCE to 500 BCE. He is also known by the epithet 'Sahasrarjuna', meaning 'Lord of a Thousand Heroes'.

historical_references.reference: Ivanshi is also mentioned in the Mahabharata, one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient India. He is described as the ancestor of Rama, the hero of the Ramayana, and the progenitor of the Solar Dynasty.
